```{r}
# Check if 'data' directory exists; if not, create it
if (!dir.exists(here("data"))) {
  dir.create(here("data"))
}

# Load gentrification score by tract
gentrification <- read.csv(here("data", "Data_NYC_Gentrification_2000_16.csv")) %>% 
  mutate(tractid = as.character(tractid)) %>% 
  dplyr::select(tractid, score_0.5)

# Load gentrification score if using xlsx file:
# gentrification <- read_xlsx(here("Gentrification","Data_NYC_Gentrification_2000_16.xlsx")) %>%
#   mutate(tractid = as.character(tractid)) %>%
#   dplyr::select(tractid, score_0.5)

# Pull NYC tract IDs/fips from gentrification index dataset for filtering
nyc_fips <- gentrification$tractid

# Load NYC tracts shapefile
nyc_tracts <- tracts(state = "NY", county = c("Bronx", "Kings", "New York", "Queens", "Richmond"), year = 2010) %>%
  # clean lat and long for Conley SEs
  mutate(lat = as.numeric(INTPTLAT10), long = as.numeric(INTPTLON10), GEOID = GEOID10) %>% 
  # filter for FIPS codes included in gentrification index dataset
  filter(GEOID %in% nyc_fips)


# Load NY tracts populatuion weighted centroid points from Census data
nyc_weighted_centroids <- read.table("https://www2.census.gov/geo/docs/reference/cenpop2010/tract/CenPop2010_Mean_TR36.txt", 
                         header = TRUE, sep = ",", stringsAsFactors = FALSE, 
                         colClasses = c("character", "character", "character", "numeric", "numeric", "numeric")) %>%
  mutate(FIPS = paste(STATEFP, COUNTYFP, TRACTCE, sep = "")) %>% 
  ## filter for only NYC tracts
  filter(FIPS %in% nyc_fips) %>%  
  rename(Longitude_weighted = LONGITUDE, 
         Latitude_weighted = LATITUDE)

# JH - 10/12/24 warning persists 10/13, 10/14 Warning: R metadata may have unsafe or invalid elements ℹ Type: "externalptr" options(arrow.unsafe_metadata = TRUE) #

# Temperature data
if(!file.exists(here("data","summarized_daily_temp_preds.parquet"))){download.file("https://zenodo.org/records/10557980/files/summarized_daily_temp_preds.parquet?download=1", mode = "wb",
                                                                                   destfile = here("data","summarized_daily_temp_preds.parquet"))} 

# Temperature by tract
temp <- read_parquet(here("data","summarized_daily_temp_preds.parquet")) %>%
  filter(str_detect(date, "2016")) %>%
  mutate(temp_c = mean_temp_daily_cK/100-273.15) %>% 
  mutate(temp_f = temp_c*9/5+32) %>% 
  group_by(GEOID, date) %>%
  ungroup() %>% 
  group_by(GEOID) %>% 
  summarize(mean_temp = mean(mean_temp_daily_cK/100))

# NDVI by tract (need to have it downloaded and stored locally)

ndvi_sd_2016 <- rast(here("data", "ndvi_c2_2000_2.tif")) %>%

# PM2.5 data

download_data <- function() {
  # set longer timeout
  options(timeout = 7200)
  if(!file.exists(here("data", "2016_pm25_daily_average.txt.gz"))){download.file("https://ofmpub.epa.gov/rsig/rsigserver?data/FAQSD/outputs/2016_pm25_daily_average.txt.gz", destfile = here("data", "2016_pm25_daily_average.txt.gz"))} #2016
  if(!file.exists(here("data", "2002_pm25_daily_average.txt.gz"))){download.file("https://ofmpub.epa.gov/rsig/rsigserver?data/FAQSD/outputs/2002_pm25_daily_average.txt.gz", destfile = here("data", "2002_pm25_daily_average.txt.gz"))}} #2002
download_data()

# Read in PM2.5 daily average by census tract from EPA FAQSD - 2002
pm_tract_2002 <- read.delim(gzfile(here("data", "2002_pm25_daily_average.txt.gz")), sep = ",") %>%
  ## Include only NYC tracts
  filter(FIPS %in% nyc_fips) %>%
  ## Convert FIPS to character for compatibility
  mutate(FIPS = as.character(FIPS)) %>%
  ## Join with population-weighted centroids
  left_join(nyc_weighted_centroids, by = "FIPS") %>%
  ## Calculate annual average by tract using population weighted centroid
  group_by(FIPS) %>%
  summarize(pm_mean_2002 = mean(pm25_daily_average.ug.m3.),

            Longitude = first(Longitude_weighted),
            Latitude = first(Latitude_weighted))

# Read in PM2.5 daily average by census tract from EPA FAQSD - 2016
pm_tract_2016 <- read.delim(gzfile(here("data", "2016_pm25_daily_average.txt.gz")), sep = ",") %>%
  ## include only NYC tracts
  filter(Loc_Label1 %in% nyc_fips) %>% 
  ## Convert Loc_Label1 to character for compatibility
  mutate(Loc_Label1 = as.character(Loc_Label1)) %>%
  ## Join with population-weighted centroids
  left_join(nyc_weighted_centroids, by = c("Loc_Label1" = "FIPS")) %>%
  ## calculate annual average by tract using population weighted centroid
  group_by(Loc_Label1) %>%
  summarize(pm_mean_2016 = mean(Prediction),
            pm_sd_2016 = sd(Prediction),
            Longitude = first(Longitude_weighted),
            Latitude = first(Latitude_weighted))
  
# Combine 2002 and 2016 pm data for nyc_tracts
pm_tract <- pm_tract_2002 %>%
  inner_join(pm_tract_2016, by = c("FIPS" = "Loc_Label1", "Longitude", "Latitude")) %>%

# NO2 CACES (downloaded locally)

no2_caces <- left_join(no2_2000_caces, no2_2016_caces, by = "fips") %>%

if(!file.exists(here("data", "2002_ozone_daily_8hour_maximum.txt.gz"))){download.file("https://ofmpub.epa.gov/rsig/rsigserver?data/FAQSD/outputs/2002_ozone_daily_8hour_maximum.txt.gz", destfile = here("data", "2002_ozone_daily_8hour_maximum.txt.gz"))} #2002

# Read in ozone daily 8-hour maximum by census tract from EPA FAQSD (external file) - 2002
o3_tract_2002 <- read.delim(gzfile(here("data", "2002_ozone_daily_8hour_maximum.txt.gz")), sep = ",") %>% 
  ## include only NYC tracts
  filter(FIPS %in% nyc_fips) %>%

  group_by(FIPS) %>%

# Read in ozone daily 8-hour maximum by census tract from EPA FAQSD (external file) - 2016
o3_tract_2016 <- read.delim(gzfile(here("data", "2016_ozone_daily_8hour_maximum.txt.gz")), sep = ",") %>%
  ## include only NYC tracts
  filter(Loc_Label1 %in% nyc_fips) %>%

  mutate(Loc_Label1 = as.character(Loc_Label1)) %>%

o3_tract <- o3_tract_2002 %>%

# Merge all exposure data
all_data <- nyc_tracts %>% 
  # join gentrification index by tract
  right_join(gentrification, by = c("GEOID10" = "tractid")) %>%
  left_join(pm_tract, by = c("GEOID" = "FIPS"))  %>% 
  mutate(pm_2016 = pm_mean_2016, pm_2002 = pm_mean_2002, pm_change = pm_2016-pm_2002) %>% 
  left_join(o3_tract, by = c("GEOID" = "FIPS"))  %>% 
  mutate(o3_2016 = o3_mean_2016, o3_2002 = o3_mean_2002, o3_change = o3_2016-o3_2002, o3_sd_2016 = o3_sd_2016, o3_sd_2002 = o3_sd_2002) %>% 
  left_join(no2_caces, by = c("GEOID" = "fips")) %>% 
  mutate(no2_change = no2_2016-no2_2000) %>% 
  mutate(ndvi_mean_2016 = ndvi_mean_2016, ndvi_mean_2000 = ndvi_mean_2000, ndvi_change = ndvi_mean_2016-ndvi_mean_2000) %>%
  mutate(ndvi_sd_2016 = ndvi_sd_2016, ndvi_sd_2000 = ndvi_sd_2000) %>%

############# Median income ###############################
# Find median household income variable in 2000 decennial census
all_vars_dec <- 
  load_variables(year = 2000, dataset = "sf3")

# Models adjusting for median income in 2000 (note: 2000 decennial census is 1999 data)
income_2000 <- get_decennial(variables = "P053001", year = 2000,  sumfile = "sf3", state = "NY", 
                  county = c("Queens", "King", "New York", "Richmond", "Bronx"), geography = "tract") %>% 
  rename(med_income_2000 = value)
#results in 226 missing tracts in terms of 2010 tracts.

# Find median household income variable in 2010 American Community Survey
income_2010 <- get_acs(variables = "B06011_001", year = 2010, state = "NY", 
                  county = c("Queens", "King", "New York", "Richmond", "Bronx"), geography = "tract") %>% 
  rename(med_income_2010 = estimate)

# Joining both income sets with data and imputing 2010 data where 2000 data is missing
all_data_inc <- all_data %>%
  left_join(income_2000, by = "GEOID") %>%
  left_join(income_2010, by = "GEOID") %>%
  mutate(med_income_2000_impute = coalesce(med_income_2000, med_income_2010)) %>% 
  # coerce GEOID to numeric then factor class to avoid error in MRF smooth
  mutate(GEOID = as.numeric(GEOID)) %>% 
  mutate(GEOID = factor(GEOID)) %>% 
 # coerce COUNTYFP10 to numeric then factor class to avoid error ?
  mutate(COUNTYFP10 = as.numeric(COUNTYFP10)) %>% 
  mutate(COUNTYFP10 = factor(COUNTYFP10))

# Ranking median income 
all_data_inc$med_income_ranked <- rank(all_data_inc$med_income_2000_impute)


# Converting median income to deciles and scaling
# Create deciles
income_quantiles <- quantile(all_data_inc$med_income_2000_impute, probs = seq(0, 1, by = 0.1))
all_data_inc$med_income_decile <- findInterval(all_data_inc$med_income_2000_impute, 
                                             income_quantiles,
                                             rightmost.closed = TRUE)
```

### Create spatial neighbors matrix 
```{r}
# Create spatial neighbors matrix and identify isolated areas
neighbors <- poly2nb(nyc_tracts, queen = TRUE, snap = sqrt(0.00))
neighbors_mat <- nb2mat(neighbors, zero.policy = TRUE, style = "B")

# Check for areas with no neighbors
row_sums <- rowSums(neighbors_mat)
isolated_areas <- which(row_sums == 0)

if(length(isolated_areas) > 0) {
  cat("Found", length(isolated_areas), "areas with no neighbors:\n")
  for(i in isolated_areas) {
    cat("Row", i, "- GEOID:", nyc_tracts$GEOID[i], "\n")
  }
}

# Manually connect the two Rockaway tracts (rows 1287 and 1586)
# Make them neighbors of each other
neighbors_mat[1287, 1586] <- 1
neighbors_mat[1586, 1287] <- 1

# Verify the fix
cat("\nAfter manual connection:\n")
cat("Row 1287 neighbors:", sum(neighbors_mat[1287, ]), "\n")
cat("Row 1586 neighbors:", sum(neighbors_mat[1586, ]), "\n")

# Final check for any remaining isolated areas
final_row_sums <- rowSums(neighbors_mat)
remaining_isolated <- which(final_row_sums == 0)

if(length(remaining_isolated) == 0) {
  cat("Success! No isolated areas remaining.\n")
} else {
  cat("Still have", length(remaining_isolated), "isolated areas.\n")
}

# Check final matrix
W_matrix <- neighbors_mat
# Check if any diagonal elements are not zero
any(diag(W_matrix) != 0)  

# Ensure data ordering matches spatial matrix - the data must be sorted in the same order as the rows/columns of W_matrix

all_data_inc <- all_data_inc[order(all_data_inc$GEOID), ]
```

### CARBayes Model Fitting

<details>
```{r}
set.seed(123) 

# Model fitting for PM2.5 with standard deviations
fit_pm_sd <- S.CARleroux(
  formula = pm_change ~ score_0.5 + med_income_decile + pm_sd_2002 + pm_sd_2016 + COUNTYFP10,
  data = all_data_inc,
  family = "gaussian",
  W = W_matrix,  # spatial neighbors matrix
  burnin = 10000,
  thin = 10,
  n.sample = 110000,
  #n.chains = 1, 
  prior.mean.beta = rep(0.00, times = 9),  # covariates + intercept (COUNTY as factor so 9)
  prior.var.beta = rep(100.00^2, times = 9),
  prior.tau2 = c(0.01, 0.01)
)

# Model fitting for NDVI with standard deviations
fit_ndvi_sd <- S.CARleroux(
  formula = ndvi_change ~ score_0.5 + med_income_decile + ndvi_sd_2000 + ndvi_sd_2016 + COUNTYFP10,
  data = all_data_inc,
  family = "gaussian",
  W = W_matrix,
  burnin = 10000,
  thin = 10,
  n.sample = 110000,
  #n.chains = 1,
  prior.mean.beta = rep(0.00, times = 9),  # covariates + intercept (COUNTY as factor so 9)
  prior.var.beta = rep(100.00^2, times = 9),
  prior.tau2 = c(0.01, 0.01)
)

# Model fitting for O3 with standard deviations
fit_o3_sd <- S.CARleroux(
  formula = o3_change ~ score_0.5 + med_income_decile + o3_sd_2002 + o3_sd_2016 + COUNTYFP10,
  data = all_data_inc,
  family = "gaussian",
  W = W_matrix,
  burnin = 10000,
  thin = 10,
  n.sample = 110000,
  #n.chains = 1,
  prior.mean.beta = rep(0.00, times = 9),  # covariates + intercept (COUNTY as factor so 9)
  prior.var.beta = rep(100.00^2, times = 9),
  prior.tau2 = c(0.01, 0.01)
)

# Model fitting for NO2 (without standard deviations as not available)
fit_no2_NO_sd <- S.CARleroux(
  formula = no2_change ~ score_0.5 + med_income_decile + COUNTYFP10,
  data = all_data_inc,
  family = "gaussian",
  W = W_matrix,
  burnin = 10000,
  thin = 10,
  n.sample = 110000,
  #n.chains = 1,
  prior.mean.beta = rep(0.00, times = 7),  # covariates + intercept (COUNTY as factor so 7)
  prior.var.beta = rep(100.00^2, times = 7),
  prior.tau2 = c(0.01, 0.01)
)

# Model fitting for Temperature (no standard deviation)
fit_temp <- S.CARleroux(
  formula = mean_temp ~ score_0.5 + med_income_decile + COUNTYFP10,
  data = all_data_inc,
  family = "gaussian",
  W = W_matrix,
  burnin = 10000,
  thin = 10,
  n.sample = 110000,
  #n.chains = 1,
  prior.mean.beta = rep(0.00, times = 7),  # covariates + intercept (COUNTY as factor so 7)
  prior.var.beta = rep(100.00^2, times = 7),
  prior.tau2 = c(0.01, 0.01)
)
```

### Enviro Variables and Gentrification Forest Plot (Figure 2)
```{r}
# Function to extract results from CARBayes model
extract_carbayes_results <- function(model, covariate_name) {
  if(is.null(model$summary.results)) {
    warning("Model does not contain summary.results")
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  # Extract coefficient estimates
  coefficients <- model$summary.results
  
  # Find the row corresponding to the covariate
  covariate_row <- which(rownames(coefficients) == covariate_name)
  
  if(length(covariate_row) == 0) {
    warning(paste("Covariate", covariate_name, "not found in model"))
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  # Extract estimate and credible intervals
  estimate <- coefficients[covariate_row, "Mean"] # point estimate
  lower_ci <- coefficients[covariate_row, "2.5%"]
  upper_ci <- coefficients[covariate_row, "97.5%"]
  
  # Calculate standard error approximation from credible interval
  # SE ≈ (Upper - Lower) / 3.92 for 95% CI
  std_error <- (upper_ci - lower_ci) / 3.92
  
  # Check if 95% CI includes 0 
  significant <- lower_ci > 0 | upper_ci < 0
  
  return(list(
    estimate = estimate,
    std_error = std_error,
    lower = lower_ci,
    upper = upper_ci,
    significant = significant
  ))
}

# Extract results from each model for the gentrification score (score_0.5)
results_list <- list()

# PM2.5 model
pm_results <- extract_carbayes_results(fit_pm_sd, "score_0.5")
if(!is.null(pm_results)) results_list[["PM2.5"]] <- pm_results

# NDVI model
ndvi_results <- extract_carbayes_results(fit_ndvi_sd, "score_0.5")
if(!is.null(ndvi_results)) results_list[["NDVI"]] <- ndvi_results

# O3 model
o3_results <- extract_carbayes_results(fit_o3_sd, "score_0.5")
if(!is.null(o3_results)) results_list[["O3"]] <- o3_results

# NO2 model
no2_results <- extract_carbayes_results(fit_no2_NO_sd, "score_0.5")
if(!is.null(no2_results)) results_list[["NO2"]] <- no2_results

# Temperature model
temp_results <- extract_carbayes_results(fit_temp, "score_0.5")
if(!is.null(temp_results)) results_list[["Temperature"]] <- temp_results

# Check if we have any results
if(length(results_list) == 0) {
  stop("No results were successfully extracted from the models.")
}

# Create data frame from results
# Using expressions as unicodes aren't rendering properly anymore (Feb 2026)
outcome_labels <- list(
  "PM2.5" = expression(PM[2.5]~Change),
  "NO2" = expression(NO[2]~Change), 
  "O3" = expression(O[3]~Change),
  "NDVI" = "NDVI Change",
  "Temperature" = "Mean Temperature"
)

# Create data frame
data <- data.frame(
  outcome = names(results_list),
  estimate = sapply(results_list, function(x) x$estimate),
  std_error = sapply(results_list, function(x) x$std_error),
  lower = sapply(results_list, function(x) x$lower),
  upper = sapply(results_list, function(x) x$upper),
  significant = sapply(results_list, function(x) x$significant),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# Create columns for display with 3 decimal places for environmental data
data <- data %>%
  mutate(
    est_ci = sprintf("%.3f (%.3f, %.3f)", estimate, lower, upper),
    outcome_order = case_when(
      outcome == "PM2.5" ~ 1,
      outcome == "NO2" ~ 2,
      outcome == "O3" ~ 3,
      outcome == "NDVI" ~ 4,
      outcome == "Temperature" ~ 5,
      TRUE ~ 6
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(outcome_order)

# Setup forest plot data structures
left_text <- list()
means <- list()
lower_limits <- list()
upper_limits <- list()
right_text <- list()
is_summary_row <- list()

row_count <- 1

# Add header row
left_text[[row_count]] <- c("Environmental Variable")
means[[row_count]] <- NA
lower_limits[[row_count]] <- NA
upper_limits[[row_count]] <- NA
right_text[[row_count]] <- c("Effect (95% CrI)")  # Credible Interval for Bayesian
is_summary_row[[row_count]] <- TRUE
row_count <- row_count + 1

# Add data rows 
for (i in 1:nrow(data)) {
  row <- data[i, ]
  # Use the label from outcome_labels (now as expressions)
  left_text[[row_count]] <- outcome_labels[[row$outcome]]
  means[[row_count]] <- row$estimate
  lower_limits[[row_count]] <- row$lower
  upper_limits[[row_count]] <- row$upper
  right_text[[row_count]] <- c(row$est_ci)
  is_summary_row[[row_count]] <- FALSE
  row_count <- row_count + 1
}

# Convert lists to vectors
means <- unlist(means)
lower_limits <- unlist(lower_limits)
upper_limits <- unlist(upper_limits)
is_summary_row <- unlist(is_summary_row)

# Get number of rows
n_rows <- length(means)

# Build tabletext as a list of columns (required for expressions to work)
col1 <- left_text  # Keep as list (contains expressions)
col2 <- as.list(rep("", n_rows))  # Empty column for graph
col3 <- right_text  # Keep as list

# Combine into tabletext as a list
tabletext <- list(col1, col2, col3)

# Generate horizontal line positions - line after header
hline_positions <- c(2)  # Line after header

# Create horizontal lines
hrzl_lines <- lapply(hline_positions, function(pos) {
  gpar(lwd = 1)
})
names(hrzl_lines) <- as.character(hline_positions)

# Create the forest plot function
create_forest_plot <- function() {
  forestplot(
    tabletext,
    means,
    lower_limits,
    upper_limits,
    is.summary = is_summary_row,
    graph.pos = 2,
    txt_gp = fpTxtGp(
      label = gpar(fontface = "plain", cex = 0.8, fontfamily = "Arial"),
      ticks = gpar(fontface = "plain", cex = 0.8, fontfamily = "Arial"),
      xlab = gpar(fontface = "plain", cex = 0.8, fontfamily = "Arial"),
      title = gpar(fontface = "plain", cex = 0.9, fontfamily = "Arial")
    ),
    col = fpColors(
      box = "black",
      line = "black",
      summary = "black"
    ),
    boxsize = 0.15,
    lineheight = unit(10, "mm"),
    graphwidth = unit(120, "mm"),
    lwd.ci = 2,
    ci.vertices = TRUE,
    ci.vertices.height = 0.15,
    xlab = "Association with Gentrification Score",
    zero = 0,
    grid = TRUE,
    lty.zero = 2,
    # Adjusted x-axis ticks for better visibility
    xticks = seq(-0.5, 0.1, 0.1),
    clip = c(-0.5, 0.1),  # Adjusted clipping range
    hrzl_lines = hrzl_lines,
    align = c("l", "c", "r"),
    colgap = unit(8, "mm"),
    mar = unit(c(10, 10, 10, 10), "mm")
  )
}

# Save as TIFF 
tiff_file <- "environmental_forest_plot.tiff"
tiff(tiff_file,
     width = 12, height = 8,
     units = "in",
     compression = "lzw",
     res = 600,
     type = "cairo")

create_forest_plot()
dev.off()

# Display forest plot
create_forest_plot()

# Print summary of results 
for(i in 1:nrow(data)) {
  row <- data[i, ]
  sig_text <- ifelse(row$significant, "Significant", "Not significant")
  
  var_name <- switch(row$outcome,
                     "PM2.5" = "PM2.5",
                     "NO2" = "NO2", 
                     "O3" = "O3",
                     "NDVI" = "NDVI",
                     "Temperature" = "Temperature")
  
  cat(sprintf("%-15s: %7.3f (95%% CrI: %7.3f, %7.3f) - %s\n", 
              paste(var_name, "Change"), row$estimate, row$lower, row$upper, sig_text))
}
```

### Figure 1 descriptive enviro variable maps
```{r}
# Calculate z-scores for each environmental variable
all_data_mapped <- all_data_inc %>%
  mutate(
    # Z-scores for change variables
    pm_change_z = scale(pm_change)[,1],
    o3_change_z = scale(o3_change)[,1],
    no2_change_z = scale(no2_change)[,1],
    ndvi_change_z = scale(ndvi_change)[,1],
    # Z-score for mean temperature 2016
    temp_2016_z = scale(mean_temp)[,1]
  ) 

# Create NYC boundary from actual data
nyc_boundary <- st_union(all_data_mapped)

# Download water features for NYC area
water_bodies <- area_water(state = "NY", county = c("New York", "Kings", "Queens", "Bronx", "Richmond"))

# Crop water bodies to study area
water_within_bounds <- st_intersection(water_bodies, st_union(all_data_mapped))

# Define common theme without grid lines
map_theme <- theme_void() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    plot.margin = margin(10, 10, 10, 10),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    axis.line = element_blank(),
    axis.text = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks = element_blank(),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 16, hjust = 0.5, face = "bold")
  )

# Create individual maps with updated borders
# PM2.5 Change Map

  geom_sf(data = nyc_boundary, fill = "white", color = NA) +
  geom_sf(data = all_data_mapped, aes(fill = pm_change_z), 
          color = "grey", linewidth = 0.1) +  # Grey borders on polygons
  geom_sf(data = water_within_bounds, fill = "white", color = "grey", linewidth = 0.1) + 
  scale_fill_gradient2(
    high = "#8c510a", mid = "#e6d3b7", low = "#01665e",
    midpoint = 0, limits = c(-3, 3), oob = squish, 
    guide = "none"  
  ) +
  labs(title = expression(PM[2.5])) +
  map_theme

# Create legend
create_horizontal_legend <- function() {
  legend_df <- data.frame(
    z_score = seq(-3, 3, length.out = 100),
    dummy = 1
  )
  
  legend_plot <- ggplot(legend_df, aes(x = z_score, y = dummy, fill = z_score)) +
    geom_tile(height = 0.001, width = 0.08) +  
    scale_fill_gradient2(
      high = "#8c510a",      
      mid = "#e6d3b7",      
      low = "#01665e",       
      midpoint = 0, 
      name = "Z-score",
      limits = c(-3, 3),
      breaks = c(-3, -2, -1, 0, 1, 2, 3),
      labels = c("-3", "-2", "-1", "0", "1", "2", "3")
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(limits = c(-3, 3)) +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0.9975, 1.0025)) +
    annotate("text", x = c(-3, -2, -1, 0, 1, 2, 3), y = 0.999, 
             label = c("-3", "-2", "-1", "0", "1", "2", "3"), 
             size = 4, hjust = 0.5) +
    annotate("text", x = 0, y = 0.9982, label = "Z-score", size = 4.5, hjust = 0.5) +
    theme_void() +
    theme(
      axis.text = element_blank(),
      axis.title = element_blank(),
      legend.position = "none",
      plot.margin = margin(5, 20, 5, 20)
    )
  
  return(legend_plot)
}

# Create legend
horizontal_legend <- create_horizontal_legend()

# Create final plot
final_plot <- wrap_plots(
  pm_map, o3_map, 
  no2_map, temp_map,
  ndvi_map, horizontal_legend,
  ncol = 2, nrow = 3,
  heights = c(1, 1, 1)
)

# Save as TIFF
ggsave(
  filename = "environmental_maps_panel.tiff",
  plot = final_plot,
  width = 10,
  height = 15,
  dpi = 300,
  compression = "lzw"
)

# Display final plot
print(final_plot)
```
